exposure: operative treatment using closed reduction and internal fixation (CRIF)
outcome: collapse and further displacement of the femoral neck (postoperative)
cohort: A 38-year-old female at 28 weeks of gestation who suffered a displaced sub-capital femoral neck fracture without obvious trauma.
finding: A pregnant patient diagnosed with Transient Osteoporosis of Pregnancy (TOP) complicated by a displaced femoral neck fracture successfully recovered and achieved fracture consolidation following a staged operative treatment.
mod_finding: The patient underwent a cesarean section at 38 weeks of gestation with no complications.
